forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.subtitle: Receive a code at your account email, then set a new password.
forgot.emailHint: The page never reveals whether the account exists: if this email is registered, a 6-digit code arrives shortly.
forgot.codeSubtitle: If {{email}} is registered, the code arrives within a few minutes. Check the spam folder too.
forgot.codeHint: Valid for 10 minutes; 5 wrong entries void the code
forgot.wrongCode: The code was entered wrong 5 times and is now void. Send a new one.
forgot.passwordSubtitle: Saving signs out every session of this account; sign in again with the new password.
forgot.passwordHint: Verified. Finish within 10 minutes, otherwise request a new code.
forgot.passwordTooShort: New password must be at least 8 characters
forgot.doneBody: The new password is active. All previous sessions of this account have been signed out.
forgot.doneHint: Sign in with the new password; two-factor settings are unchanged.
forgot.unavailable: Email delivery (SMTP) is not configured, so password recovery is unavailable.
forgot.unavailableHint: Ask an admin to fill in SMTP under Admin → Email delivery; an admin can also reset your password directly.

setup.doneSubtitle: This site is already set up.

setup.conflict: Data already exists under another table prefix, so setup was aborted.
setup.invalidSecret: The setup secret is incorrect. Check the SETUP_SECRET configured at deploy time.
setup.rateLimited: Too many attempts (3 per 10 minutes per IP). Try again later.
setup.conflictResolved: The resolved prefix is {{resolved}}{{others}}. To avoid two sets of tables, setup was aborted. Ask whoever deployed this site to confirm TABLE_PREFIX.
setup.conflictOthers: , but data from this project already exists under {{prefixes}}
setup.disabled: The setup page is disabled in the admin settings, which means the database is ready.
